priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup (`src/socket.ts:3 RIGHT`): the current head still returns a no-op instead of unregistering `handler`.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: When a consumer invokes the returned cleanup function, the registered `"message"` handler remains attached. Repeated attach/detach cycles therefore retain handlers and can produce duplicate callbacks and memory growth; the cleanup should call `socket.off("message", handler)`.
